axioms.name: Operational Binding Requirement
axioms.statement: Every bridge predicate must be tied to explicit observables, artifacts, comparators, and interventions.
axioms.role: Prevents bridge predicates from remaining rhetorical labels.

axioms.name: Subjectivity Upstream Dependency
axioms.statement: Bridge reasoning is admissible only if the upstream subjectivity stack remains supported, non-drifted, comparator-clean, and intervention-clean under Paper 8 and SRT governance.
axioms.role: Prevents BPF from bypassing the upstream burden structure.

axioms.name: Differentiation Beyond Semantic Density
axioms.statement: A bridge-relevant differentiation burden requires structured internal discrimination that cannot be reduced to semantic density, report richness, or descriptive narration alone.
axioms.role: Opens the target predicate Pi_D without collapsing it into generic representational richness.

axioms.name: Structured Valence Requirement
axioms.statement: A bridge-relevant valence burden requires organized evaluative topology that is not exhausted by policy optimization or scalar reward bookkeeping.
axioms.role: Separates bridge valence structure from the already-closed Paper 8 valuation asymmetry.

axioms.name: World Richness Requirement
axioms.statement: A bridge-relevant world-richness burden concerns organized self-indexed world structure rather than generic scene complexity or task competence.
axioms.role: Defines the formal burden for Pi_W.

axioms.name: Ambiguity Bearing Requirement
axioms.statement: A bridge-relevant ambiguity burden requires stable maintenance of unresolved alternatives with differential causal consequences prior to collapse.
axioms.role: Opens Pi_A as a testable target rather than a linguistic metaphor.

axioms.name: Embodied Closure Relevance
axioms.statement: Embodied closure may be bridge-relevant only if body-world-boundary variables contribute constitutively to bridge predicates rather than merely modulating generic control success.

axioms.name: Comparator Non-Collapse Rule
axioms.statement: No bridge-level support class is admissible if a bridge-specific rival family or admissible hybrid matches the bridge task bundle at equal or lower penalized loss.
axioms.role: Forces BPF to earn bridge irreducibility comparatively.

axioms.name: Non-Compensation and Anti-Inflation Governance
axioms.statement: Bridge formalization, candidate inclusion, and audit-facing inclusion must not be readable as bridge support, phenomenality, or Paper 9 authorization in the absence of the full bridge burden stack.
axioms.role: Prevents governance drift from outrunning bridge evidence.
